newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel barge premiums gain, cargoes inactive.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel barge premiums gain, cargoes inactive.

text.p: NWE jet fuel barge premiums firmed on Friday on improved demand and tight supply, traders said.
A 2,000 tonne parcel changed hands at Jan IPE +$26.75, around $2 firmer. Cargoes were notionally steady at Jan IPE +$33 cif NWE.
Benchmark Jan IPE futures rose $7.25 to $212.50 a tonne following NYMEX gains on forecasts of cold weather in Europe and the U.S.
Private forecasters WSC said western European temperatures would continue well below average for the time of year. WSC also saw below-average temperatures in the U.S. midwest next week.
